name: Zocks
description: Zocks connects Claude to the client data financial advisors rely on - including conversation intelligence, meeting insights, and the goals, concerns, and planning opportunities captured across every interaction. With access to this context through Zocks, Claude can analyze client history to surface tax considerations, estate planning signals, and other client-specific insights advisors may want to explore further.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Zocks to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Zocks to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.zocks.io/v1/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Zocks MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Zocks provides these MCP tools: contacts_search_contacts, contacts_get_contact_details, meetings_list_past_sessions, meetings_list_upcoming_sessions, meetings_get_transcript, ai_results_list_results, ai_results_get_ai_result, and ai_results_get_agent_result.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Zocks?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Zocks in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.
Zocks requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Zocks is developed by Zocks. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
